comments.body: Hi @amifalk, AutoContinuous does not work with enumerated models. We should raise a better error message for this.

comments.body: Is there a way to add this functionality (even if only for a subset of models), or is it a limitation of numpyro?

comments.body: Yes, it's the limitation of the blackbox one. It would be much easier to write custom guides for your models.
